content:
A vehicle struck a 2-inch water meter near the intersection of Windridge Drive and Winfield Parkway in Laredo on Sunday morning, causing a significant water leak, according to an advisory posted by District 6 City Council Member Tyler King.

City of Laredo Utilities crews are responding to replace the damaged shutoff valve and complete the repairs. A service notice posted by the council member lists the repair as starting at 9:11 a.m. on Sunday, November 8, with an estimated duration of 8 to 12 hours.

Residents within approximately a one-mile radius of Windridge Drive and Winfield Parkway may experience low water pressure or temporary water interruptions while the work is underway. Crews plan to relieve pressure through nearby fire hydrants rather than shutting down larger sections of the water system, in an effort to minimize service disruptions.

King said he is in communication with Utilities and will continue providing updates as repairs progress. Drivers are asked to use caution when traveling through the area.

Source: Dr. Tyler King, City Council Member for District 6, Facebook, November 8, 2026.

title: Vehicle strikes water meter at Windridge and Winfield; nearby residents may see low pressure
